author: Great Lakes Wire
title: Dearborn Heights officials honor fallen heroes at Memorial Day services
text:
Mayor Mo Baydoun joined several city officials at local Memorial Day events on May 27 to honor the nation’s fallen heroes. The commemorations included services at the Stitt American Legion Post and a Memorial Day Mass at St. Hedwig Cemetery, where wreaths were laid on behalf of the City of Dearborn Heights.
Following these events, a special service was held at the Dearborn Heights Police Department to mark the 20th anniversary of Corporal Jason Makowski’s on-duty death. City representatives participated in each ceremony as part of their annual observance.
The Memorial Day activities provided an opportunity for residents and officials to remember those who have served and sacrificed in defense of the country.
Memorial Day is observed annually across communities nationwide as a day to honor military personnel who have died in service.
